metadata.description: Agent skills for iOS development on Apple platforms

plugins.name: swiftui-reviewer
plugins.description: Reviews SwiftUI code for best practices on modern APIs, maintainability, and performance.

plugins.name: swiftui-view-gen
plugins.description: Generates SwiftUI views from Figma designs.

plugins.name: security-review
plugins.description: Comprehensive iOS security assessment against OWASP MASVS and Apple security guidelines. Reviews authentication, data storage, network security, secrets management, and more.

plugins.name: data-layer
plugins.description: Creates or reviews the iOS Data layer for a given domain, following ICT's mandatory architecture (Model → TargetType → RemoteDataSource → Repository).

plugins.name: unit-testing
plugins.description: Writes or reviews iOS unit tests for data layer (Repository) and ViewModel code, following ICT's XCTest + Combine testing patterns.

plugins.name: create-pull-request-against-development
plugins.description: Creates a pull request against the team's development branch, validating branch naming, using ICT's MR template (Overview + Ticket + Checklist), validating the ticket-tag commit format before opening the PR.

plugins.name: localization-review
plugins.description: Reviews Swift/SwiftUI code for missing or incorrect String Catalog (.xcstrings) localization coverage, flags legacy NSLocalizedString/.strings usage, and — with approval — mechanically wraps flagged strings in String(localized:).

plugins.name: prepare-release
plugins.description: Creates a release branch (release/vX.Y.Z) from main, verifies the app version before branching, and optionally hands off to create-ipa for a production build.

plugins.name: create-ipa
plugins.description: Builds and exports a debug .ipa (Debugging distribution, automatic signing) to ~/Downloads for a chosen scheme, from whatever branch is currently checked out.

plugins.name: add-navigation-route
plugins.description: Wires a new screen into ICT's enum-based navigation system — adds the route case, wires the central render switch, and wires or reports the entry-point call site.
